remarks: Recently renovated 3-bedroom, 1-bath apartment conveniently located near Downtown Stamford, with easy access to I-95, Route 1, shopping, and restaurants. This bright and inviting home features a spacious open-concept layout, seamlessly connecting the living, dining, and kitchen areas for comfortable everyday living. The brand-new kitchen offers modern cabinetry, new countertops, and all-new stainless steel appliances. Three generously sized bedrooms provide ample living space, complemented by a beautifully updated full bathroom. Additional features include an in-unit washer and dryer and two assigned parking spaces. This move-in-ready apartment combines modern updates, a functional layout, and a convenient location close to transportation, shopping, dining, and other everyday amenities.
